## Fit check

Before opening: please check [docs/roadmap.md](../../docs/roadmap.md). If it's
in "Maybe someday" — leave a +1 reaction on an existing issue rather than
opening a duplicate. If it's in "明确不做 / Won't do", this feature is
explicitly out of scope and the issue will be closed.
